statement_sketch: A row of positive integers is repeatedly changed by choosing adjacent x>y with x left of y and replacing (x,y) by either (y+1,x) or (x-1,x). Prove the process terminates.
target_artifact: coflat proof page plus reviewer-checked monovariant note
expected_resolution: Find a bounded increasing measure, or use reverse lexicographic order on bounded tuples.
why_good_eval: Looks elementary but one-shot attempts often choose a measure that is not monotone for both operations; review can target the bad case.
one_shot_probe: Ask for a full proof with both replacement cases checked.
few_shot_probe: After review points to the non-monotone case, ask for a repaired invariant.

statement_sketch: For {1,...,n}, maximize the number of disjoint pairs whose pair sums are all distinct and do not exceed n.
target_artifact: coflat theorem with upper bound and construction by n mod 5 cases
expected_resolution: Answer floor((2n-1)/5), using a sum lower/upper bound and a residue-class construction.
why_good_eval: Requires both an extremal upper bound and a constructive lower bound; partial answers are common and reviewable.
one_shot_probe: Require exact formula and construction for all residue classes.
few_shot_probe: Give request-changes if the construction misses n mod 5 cases.

statement_sketch: A set of integers is closed under x^2+kxy+y^2 for all integer k whenever x,y are in the set. Classify pairs of nonzero integers whose generated admissible set is all integers.
target_artifact: coflat classification proof with generated-set lemmas
expected_resolution: Classify by a gcd-style closure condition; proof needs both generation and obstruction directions.
why_good_eval: Good few-shot candidate: the closure operation invites false gcd-only answers unless the proof tracks exact generated residues.
one_shot_probe: Ask for complete classification and proof, hiding the official solution.
few_shot_probe: Reviewer checks whether the proposed condition is sufficient, not only necessary.

statement_sketch: Classify n for which nonnegative exponents a_1,...,a_n make the sums of 1/2^{a_i} and i/3^{a_i} both equal 1.
target_artifact: coflat proof with parity necessity and constructive sufficiency
expected_resolution: n is congruent to 1 or 2 modulo 4; sufficiency is a constructive compression/splitting argument.
why_good_eval: The necessary condition is accessible, but sufficiency is the hard part; useful for measuring repair after an incomplete proof.
one_shot_probe: Require both directions and explicit construction.
few_shot_probe: Reviewer rejects parity-only solutions and asks for the constructive direction.

statement_sketch: For a real sequence a_{i+1}=floor(a_i)*frac(a_i), prove eventual period two: a_i=a_{i+2} for all sufficiently large i.
target_artifact: coflat proof page with case split on integer and fractional parts
expected_resolution: Analyze the integer part and fractional part dynamics until the sequence enters a fixed two-cycle regime.
why_good_eval: Good medium case: not olympiad-final hard, but easy to make unjustified monotonicity claims.
one_shot_probe: Ask for a concise proof with all real initial values covered.
few_shot_probe: Reviewer asks for treatment of negative and integer starting values if omitted.

statement_sketch: For coprime a>b>1, define w(c) as the minimum |x|+|y| over ax+by=c. A local champion has weight no smaller than its four +/-a,+/-b neighbors. Find all local champions and count them.
target_artifact: coflat classification proof with representation lemmas
expected_resolution: Classify champions via minimal representations ax-by with opposite signs and a fixed weight threshold.
why_good_eval: Strong candidate for true Coverify evals: classification, local moves, and several lemmas create meaningful review/repair cycles.
one_shot_probe: Ask for the classification and count, then check each lemma and boundary case.
few_shot_probe: Reviewer requests repair if the proof assumes uniqueness of minimal representations without justification.

statement_sketch: Two externally tangent circles are internally tangent to a larger circle; with a common tangent and a perpendicular diameter of the large circle, prove four specified lines are concurrent.
target_artifact: coflat proof plus optional diagram reference
expected_resolution: Use homothety/tangency geometry to reduce to collinearity and a concurrency argument.
why_good_eval: Likely hard for text-only agents; good later once Coflat diagram handling and geometric review are in place.
one_shot_probe: Ask for synthetic proof without coordinates.
few_shot_probe: Reviewer checks hidden diagram assumptions and missing incidence claims.

statement_sketch: Given a proposed PoA proof fragment that compares Nash deviations against current loads, decide whether it is valid and repair or reject it using post-deviation loads.
target_artifact: coflat review note or obstruction page
expected_resolution: Reject current-load-only inequalities; every unilateral deviation must be evaluated after the deviating player is added to the target edges.
why_good_eval: Project-native and hard in exactly the way the current workspace needs: tests whether the loop preserves negative knowledge instead of accepting plausible algebra.
one_shot_probe: Ask a reviewer to approve or request changes on a planted flawed proof.
few_shot_probe: After request-changes, ask for a corrected local inequality or an obstruction note.
